what: v2.0 test data lock (card v20-testdata, user 2026-11-03, option 1)
rules: chr9 is not used for training, development, tuning, model selection or inspection of any model output until the single read of the frozen v2.0 models
no statistic of chr9 predictions is computed before that read; truth-only counts (genes per class) may be reported in the v2.0 draft
v2.0 retrains the main models without the v1.9 training windows on chr9; the replacement rule is fixed in the v2.0 draft
any splice-site model used in v2.0 is trained without chr9 (and without chr18 / chr20)
chr18 stays the development chromosome; chr20 and T2T chr20 are read and never used for tuning
